name: Owen Patel
bio: Owen works on the systems that keep Fieldbook available and company devices secure. He writes down the recovery steps so an incident does not depend on one person being online.
responsibilities: Technical security questions, access controls, and managed-device lock or wipe procedures.
Credential exposure, revoking active sessions, and recovering access after a lost or stolen laptop.
Platform reliability and incident runbooks. Owen participates in the on-call rotation, but is not always the current on-call engineer; use the on-call route for urgent incidents.
